headline: DPSC Limited: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process Filed
sum: DPSC Limited has filed a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP), disclosed to the NSE under SEBI's continual disclosure regime on 18 June 2026.
detail: DPSC Limited disclosed initiation of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process to the National Stock Exchange under Regulation 7(2) read with Regulation 6(2) of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015. The notification was filed on 18 June 2026. CIRP is a structured process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, designed to resolve insolvency of corporate debtors through creditor-led negotiations and plan formulation.
